title: The Way of the World
author: William Congreve
description: "The Way of the World" by William Congreve is a comedy play first performed in 1700.
longDescription: Set among London's upper class, it follows the intricate romance between Mirabell and Millamant, who must navigate deception, social maneuvering, and family obstacles to marry.

authorInfo.bio: William Congreve (1670–1729) wrote Love for Love: A Comedy. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
works: Incognita; Or, Love and Duty Reconcil'd
